analysis.evidence: שֹׁפֵךְ דַּם הָאָדָם means “whoever sheds human blood.” The following clause דָּמוֹ יִשָּׁפֵךְ, “his blood shall be shed,” echoes the verb in the passive and confirms the bloodshed sense.
analysis.morphology: Qal active participle, masculine singular construct, with no prefix or suffix. It functions substantivally and takes דַּם הָאָדָם as its object.
